baseline.name: quality_baseline
baseline.implementation_summary: Existing gate/up FP8 plus down-projection FP8 in layers 8:28

candidates.name: lm_head_fp8_shortlist_bf16_verify
candidates.hypothesis: Reading an FP8 execution head and recomputing only shortlisted logits in BF16 can halve the dominant LM-head weight traffic without changing public logits or final candidate math
candidates.implementation_summary: Use row-scaled FP8 only to shortlist 64 vocabulary IDs, recompute those rows from the resident tied BF16 head, and preserve BF16 argmax tie-breaking

candidates.name: split_k_down_projection
candidates.hypothesis: Two exact column partitions provide enough CTAs to saturate the low-row down-projection GEMV
candidates.implementation_summary: Compute two FP32 partial sums per output row and reduce them into the existing BF16 output
